entities.summary: Anthony Willis is a former British professional boxer who competed from 1981 to 1989. Willis won the Lonsdale Belt and won a light welterweight bronze medal at the 1980 Summer Olympics. As a professional, he held the British lightweight boxing title between 1985 and 1987.
